Prove your worth to the [[Norn]] by beating various bosses.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Prove your valor to Sif. Vanquish [[Koren Wildrunner]] in [[Drakkar Lake]].
* Continue proving your worth. Defeat [[Myish, Lady of the Lake|Myish, Lady Of The Lake]] in Drakkar Lake.
* Flex your valor muscle. Stomp [[Nulfastu Earthbound|Nulfastu, Earthbound]] in Drakkar Lake.
* See [[Sif Shadowhunter]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* {{Skill icon|"You Move Like a Dwarf!"}}

== Walkthrough ==
You can kill the [[boss]]es in any order and at any time. See the articles for each boss for specific combat tips. In brief, they are:

; [[Myish, Lady of the Lake]]
At the center of Drakkar Lake (northern green star).
* She is easy to kill if you first take out the Chilling Wisps and Elementals that patrol the lake.

; [[Koren Wildrunner]]
[[Patrol]]s either clockwise or counterclockwise on the shore around the lake (possible initial positions marked in blue). 
* Be careful of overlapping patrols when you confront Koren Wildrunner.
* An easy way to find him, is to follow his trail of Spirits of [[Symbiosis]].

; [[Nulfastu Earthbound]]
In the southeast corner of the map (southern green star).
* Follow a white rabbit down into a [[Rabbit Hole|small glade]].
* Watch out for numerous [[popup]]s at the top and then again at the bottom. It helps to move slowly, [[pull]]ing foes to you.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Sif Shadowhunter'''
:''"If you want the Norn to take you seriously, make a name for yourself, <[[character]] name>. Do as I have done: vanquish vicious beasts in the name of fame and glory! Many Norn post signs in their hearthsteads about the fearsome beasts they have encountered. Read the signs behind me...if you dare!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I shall defeat these foes and earn your respect.
|decline = I don't need your approval.
|ask = Crush my foes. Defeat the same creatures I have...then you will be worth something.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Sif Shadowhunter'''
:''"Wipe that smile off your face. You hardly accomplished anything of merit. I have faced and defeated far greater enemies. You puny thing. Go boast to someone who cares. Perhaps a child. Or the village idiot."''

== Notes ==
* You can combine this quest with the Zaishen bounty quests for [[Myish, Lady of the Lake (Zaishen quest)|Myish]] and [[Nulfastu, Earthbound (Zaishen quest)|Nulfastu]].

==Trivia==
* The quest name is a reference to the song [[w:Dirty_Deeds_Done_Dirt_Cheap|Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap]]  by [[w:AC/DC|AC/DC]].
